title: Yishmael ben Chananyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Avot deRabbi Natan, chapter 14, as a student of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, who called him “a garden-bed in the wilderness.” This is a scribal error: the name should read Rabbi Shimon ben Netanel.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Avot deRabbi Natan 14 paragraph names Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai and Yishmael ben Chananyah, with the epithet גרוע במדבר and inline apparatus markers. Hyman supplies ערוגה במדבר and says the name should read Rabbi Shimon ben Netanel. His emendation is retained with its full corrective force; it is not a freshly established identity or a collation of the apparatus.
